# Sanitized reviewed-lab fixture

`reviewed-lab-sanitized.zip` is a deterministic, synthetic package derived from the status transitions and cardinalities documented in the 2026-10-27 independent lab review. It contains no tenant, subscription, account, resource, or customer identifiers from the lab.

It exists only to exercise import, analysis, full-evidence preview/download, export, CSP, desktop/mobile layout, clean PDF generation, and the v3.9.5 status/evidence/localization contract. It is not evidence of a real environment.

The fixture includes one canonical CHK-42 evidence row per connected machine and the additive schema-v3 result semantics. It remains sanitized and contains no customer or Microsoft tenant identifiers.
